content: React Router supports declarative, data and Vite-based framework modes; framework mode supports SPA, SSR and prerendering. SPA mode disables runtime SSR but renders at build time, so SSR-safe code remains needed. Next.js supports Route Handlers. Vite 8 release docs require Node 20.19+ or 22.12+ and explain plugin-react v6. Sources: https://reactrouter.com/start/modes https://reactrouter.com/how-to/spa https://vite.dev/blog/announcing-vite8.html https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/route-handlers . Versions beyond the local starter remain unselected.
